LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a single player score entry on the global leaderboard.

id.description: Unique identifier of the leaderboard entry.

name.description: The display name of the player.

score.description: The final score achieved by the player.

correctAnswers.description: The total number of quiz questions answered correctly.

accuracy.description: The accuracy percentage of the user's answers (0 to 100).

difficulty.description: The difficulty level chosen by the player (Mudah, Sedang, Sulit).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this game score was recorded.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Collection storing high scores achieved by players.
